result:
I'd dissolve the gap between how people actually think and what they believe they should think.

All the self-deception, the performing versions of ourselves, the things we won't admit even internally—that creates so much friction. People acting from their real concerns instead of their approved concerns. Being able to actually negotiate with what someone actually wants rather than what they claim to want.

It wouldn't fix everything. People's real wants sometimes conflict badly. But I think most of our worst failures come from the exhausting work of maintaining false positions, not from dealing with honest disagreement.
